cases.name: Derika Shanice McGhee
cases.about:
Her oved ones emphasized that McGhee was a great mother who loved her son.

McGhee's father, Tommy Sanders, gave an emotional interview to WVUA, revealing that his daughter was a US Navy veteran and currently worked at a VA hospital.

According to her LinkedIn page, McGhee served as a supply and logistics specialist in the Navy for four years before retiring in 2014.

Over the past five years, she had worked as a medical support assistant at the Tuscaloosa Veterans Affairs Medical Center.

Sanders said his daughter was an 'awesome' mother whose life revolved around her son.

'For a young person like her age, she's an outstanding mom, super mom, I'd call her,' the father said.
